examples.src: The school did a survey on students' sleep habits.
examples.dst: 学校做了一项关于学生睡眠习惯的调查。

examples.src: The survey shows that most teenagers use phones every day.
examples.dst: 调查显示大多数青少年每天都使用手机。

examples.src: He surveyed the room before he spoke.
examples.dst: 他讲话之前环视了一下房间。

confuse.diff: servey 是常见拼写错误，正确拼写是 survey。

examples.src: Add up these numbers and tell me the total.
examples.dst: 把这些数字加起来，告诉我总数。

examples.src: Small savings add up over time.
examples.dst: 零散的积蓄会随着时间积少成多。

examples.src: His story just doesn't add up.
examples.dst: 他的说法根本说不通。

confuse.diff: add up 指合计；add to 指增加、添加到某物上。

examples.src: She was upset about the exam result.
examples.dst: 她对考试成绩感到难过。

examples.src: Don't upset your little sister.
examples.dst: 别惹你妹妹难过。

examples.src: The bad weather upset our plans.
examples.dst: 恶劣的天气打乱了我们的计划。

confuse.diff: upset 指使心烦或打乱；setup 指布置、安排。

examples.src: He ignored the warning and went on.
examples.dst: 他无视警告，继续往前走。

examples.src: You can't ignore your health problems.
examples.dst: 你不能忽视自己的健康问题。

examples.src: She ignored me when I said hello.
examples.dst: 我打招呼时她不理我。

confuse.diff: ignore 是动词，忽视；ignorant 是形容词，无知的。

examples.src: Stay calm and listen to me.
examples.dst: 保持冷静，听我说。

examples.src: The sea was calm this morning.
examples.dst: 今天早晨海面很平静。

examples.src: The teacher tried to calm the nervous students.
examples.dst: 老师努力让紧张的学生平静下来。

confuse.diff: calm 指平静；claim 指声称、要求。

examples.src: Calm down and tell me what happened.
examples.dst: 冷静下来，告诉我发生了什么。

examples.src: It took him a while to calm down after the argument.
examples.dst: 争吵之后他过了好一会儿才平静下来。

examples.src: She calmed the baby down with a song.
examples.dst: 她唱了首歌让宝宝安静下来。

confuse.diff: calm down 指情绪平静；slow down 指速度放慢。

examples.src: I have got to finish my homework tonight.
examples.dst: 我今晚必须完成作业。

examples.src: You have got to see this film.
examples.dst: 你一定要看看这部电影。

examples.src: We have got to leave before six.
examples.dst: 我们必须在六点前离开。

confuse.diff: 两者意思相近，have got to 更口语化。

examples.src: Parents show great concern for their children.
examples.dst: 父母十分关心自己的孩子。

examples.src: This matter doesn't concern you.
examples.dst: 这件事与你无关。

examples.src: Pollution is a serious public concern.
examples.dst: 污染是公众关心的严重问题。

confuse.diff: concern 指担心；concert 指音乐会。

examples.src: We are concerned about the safety of the children.
examples.dst: 我们担心孩子们的安全。

examples.src: She is concerned about her grandfather's health.
examples.dst: 她担心爷爷的健康。

examples.src: Many people are concerned about climate change.
examples.dst: 许多人关注气候变化。

confuse.diff: be concerned about 指担心；be concerned with 指与某事有关。

examples.src: I walk the dog every evening.
examples.dst: 我每天傍晚都遛狗。

examples.src: He walked the dog along the river.
examples.dst: 他沿着河边遛狗。

examples.src: Who is going to walk the dog today?
examples.dst: 今天谁去遛狗？

confuse.diff: walk the dog 是固定说法，指带狗散步。

examples.src: This shirt is too loose for me.
examples.dst: 这件衬衫我穿太宽松了。

examples.src: One of the screws is loose.
examples.dst: 有一颗螺丝松了。

examples.src: She wore her hair loose.
examples.dst: 她披着头发。

confuse.diff: loose 是形容词，松的；lose 是动词，丢失。

examples.src: We took the sick cat to the vet.
examples.dst: 我们带生病的猫去看兽医。

examples.src: My aunt works as a vet in the city.
examples.dst: 我姨妈在城里当兽医。

examples.src: The vet gave the dog an injection.
examples.dst: 兽医给狗打了一针。

confuse.diff: vet 指兽医；wet 指湿的。

examples.src: She went through a lot of pain after the accident.
examples.dst: 事故之后她经历了很多痛苦。

examples.src: Let's go through the plan once more.
examples.dst: 我们把这个计划再过一遍。

examples.src: The train goes through a long tunnel.
examples.dst: 火车穿过一条长长的隧道。

confuse.diff: go through 强调经历或检查；get through 强调完成或接通。

examples.src: Amsterdam is famous for its canals.
examples.dst: 阿姆斯特丹以运河闻名。

examples.src: Anne Frank's family hid in a house in Amsterdam.
examples.dst: 安妮·弗兰克一家躲在阿姆斯特丹的一所房子里。

examples.src: We flew to Amsterdam last summer.
examples.dst: 去年夏天我们飞到了阿姆斯特丹。

confuse.diff: Amsterdam 是荷兰首都；Rotterdam 是荷兰大港口城市鹿特丹。

examples.src: Anne was a Jewish girl who lived in Amsterdam.
examples.dst: 安妮是住在阿姆斯特丹的一名犹太女孩。

examples.src: They celebrate Jewish festivals every year.
examples.dst: 他们每年都庆祝犹太节日。

examples.src: There is a Jewish museum in the city.
examples.dst: 这座城市里有一座犹太博物馆。

confuse.diff: Jewish 是形容词；Jew 是名词，犹太人。

examples.src: The Nazis ruled Germany from 1933 to 1945.
examples.dst: 纳粹在1933年至1945年统治德国。

examples.src: Many families escaped from the Nazi army.
examples.dst: 许多家庭逃离了纳粹军队。

examples.src: The film is about a Nazi prison camp.
examples.dst: 这部电影讲的是一座纳粹集中营。

confuse.diff: Nazi 指纳粹；national 指国家的、民族的。

examples.src: He set down the heavy box carefully.
examples.dst: 他小心地放下了沉重的箱子。

examples.src: Please set down your ideas on paper.
examples.dst: 请把你的想法写在纸上。

examples.src: The bus set us down near the station.
examples.dst: 公共汽车在车站附近让我们下了车。

confuse.diff: set down 指放下东西或记下；sit down 指自己坐下。

examples.src: The museum holds a series of lectures every month.
examples.dst: 博物馆每个月举办一系列讲座。

examples.src: This TV series is popular with teenagers.
examples.dst: 这部电视剧很受青少年欢迎。

examples.src: A series of accidents happened on that road.
examples.dst: 那条路上接连发生了一系列事故。

confuse.diff: series 指系列；serious 指严肃的、严重的。

examples.src: She asked me a series of questions.
examples.dst: 她问了我一连串问题。

examples.src: A series of events changed his life.
examples.dst: 一系列事件改变了他的生活。

examples.src: The author wrote a series of books for children.
examples.dst: 这位作家为孩子们写了一系列书。

confuse.diff: a series of 指一连串；a kind of 指一种。

examples.src: The children are playing outdoors.
examples.dst: 孩子们正在户外玩耍。

examples.src: We like to eat outdoors in summer.
examples.dst: 夏天我们喜欢在户外吃饭。

examples.src: He loves the great outdoors.
examples.dst: 他热爱广阔的大自然。

confuse.diff: outdoors 是副词；outdoor 是形容词，如 outdoor activities。

examples.src: The magician's tricks spellbind the audience.
examples.dst: 魔术师的把戏使观众着迷。

examples.src: Her voice can spellbind anyone who listens.
examples.dst: 她的声音能迷住每一个听的人。

examples.src: The story spellbound the children.
examples.dst: 这个故事把孩子们迷住了。

confuse.diff: spellbind 指迷住；spell 指拼写或咒语。

examples.src: I didn't break the cup on purpose.
examples.dst: 我不是故意打破杯子的。

examples.src: He came late on purpose to avoid the work.
examples.dst: 他故意迟到以躲避工作。

examples.src: Did she hide the letter on purpose?
examples.dst: 她是故意把信藏起来的吗？

confuse.diff: on purpose 指故意；for the purpose of 指为了某个目的。

examples.src: He got up early in order to catch the first bus.
examples.dst: 他起得很早，为的是赶上第一班公共汽车。

examples.src: We work hard in order to get good grades.
examples.dst: 我们努力学习是为了取得好成绩。

examples.src: She saved money in order to travel abroad.
examples.dst: 她攒钱是为了出国旅行。

confuse.diff: in order to 后接动词原形；in order that 后接从句。

examples.src: The street lights come on at dusk.
examples.dst: 傍晚时路灯亮了。

examples.src: We reached the village at dusk.
examples.dst: 我们在黄昏时到达了村子。

examples.src: Bats come out at dusk.
examples.dst: 蝙蝠在黄昏时出来活动。

confuse.diff: dusk 指黄昏；dust 指灰尘。

examples.src: The birds return to the trees at dusk.
examples.dst: 鸟儿在黄昏时飞回树上。

examples.src: We usually take a walk at dusk.
examples.dst: 我们通常在傍晚散步。

examples.src: The shops close at dusk in this small town.
examples.dst: 在这个小镇上，商店傍晚就关门了。

confuse.diff: at dusk 指黄昏时；at dawn 指黎明时。

examples.src: We heard thunder in the distance.
examples.dst: 我们听到远处有雷声。

examples.src: The baby cried at the sound of thunder.
examples.dst: 听到雷声，宝宝哭了起来。

examples.src: It thundered all night.
examples.dst: 雷声响了一整夜。

confuse.diff: thunder 指雷声；lightning 指闪电。

examples.src: He spent the entire day reading.
examples.dst: 他整天都在看书。

examples.src: The entire class passed the test.
examples.dst: 全班同学都通过了测验。

examples.src: The entire village was covered with snow.
examples.dst: 整个村庄都被雪覆盖了。

confuse.diff: entire 指整个的；entry 指进入、入口。

examples.src: I entirely agree with you.
examples.dst: 我完全同意你的看法。

examples.src: The house was made entirely of wood.
examples.dst: 这座房子完全由木头建成。

examples.src: That is an entirely different question.
examples.dst: 那是一个完全不同的问题。

confuse.diff: entirely 是副词；entire 是形容词。

examples.src: The wind has great power.
examples.dst: 风有巨大的力量。

examples.src: The power went out during the storm.
examples.dst: 暴风雨期间停电了。

examples.src: The president has the power to make that decision.
examples.dst: 总统有权做出那个决定。

confuse.diff: power 指力量；powder 指粉末。

examples.src: They met face to face for the first time.
examples.dst: 他们第一次面对面见面。

examples.src: I'd like to talk to you face to face.
examples.dst: 我想和你当面谈谈。

examples.src: She came face to face with a bear in the forest.
examples.dst: 她在森林里与一只熊撞个正着。

confuse.diff: face to face 是固定短语；face to 本身没有这个意思。

examples.src: She closed the curtains and went to bed.
examples.dst: 她拉上窗帘上床睡觉了。

examples.src: The curtain rose and the play began.
examples.dst: 幕布升起，戏剧开始了。

examples.src: The curtains in my room are blue.
examples.dst: 我房间的窗帘是蓝色的。

confuse.diff: curtain 指窗帘；certain 指确定的。

examples.src: The old books on the shelf were dusty.
examples.dst: 架子上的旧书落满了灰尘。

examples.src: We walked along a dusty road.
examples.dst: 我们沿着一条尘土飞扬的路走。

examples.src: The attic was dark and dusty.
examples.dst: 阁楼又黑又满是灰尘。

confuse.diff: dusty 指满是灰尘；dusky 指昏暗的。

examples.src: He no longer lives in this city.
examples.dst: 他不再住在这座城市了。

examples.src: The shop is no longer open on Sundays.
examples.dst: 这家店星期天不再营业了。

examples.src: I am no longer afraid of the dark.
examples.dst: 我不再怕黑了。

confuse.diff: no longer 指不再；no longer than 指不超过某个长度。

examples.src: I can't wait any longer.
examples.dst: 我不能再等了。

examples.src: She doesn't work here any longer.
examples.dst: 她不再在这里工作了。

examples.src: They didn't stay any longer than an hour.
examples.dst: 他们停留的时间没有超过一小时。

confuse.diff: 两者常可互换，any longer 多指时间，any more 多指程度或数量。

examples.src: My dance partner is very talented.
examples.dst: 我的舞伴很有天赋。

examples.src: China is an important trade partner of many countries.
examples.dst: 中国是许多国家的重要贸易伙伴。

examples.src: Work with your partner on this task.
examples.dst: 和你的搭档一起完成这项任务。

confuse.diff: partner 指伙伴；parent 指父亲或母亲。

examples.src: They settled in a small town by the sea.
examples.dst: 他们在海边的一个小镇定居了。

examples.src: Let's settle this problem today.
examples.dst: 我们今天把这个问题解决掉吧。

examples.src: The bird settled on a branch.
examples.dst: 鸟儿落在了树枝上。

confuse.diff: settle 指定居、解决；set 指放置、设定。

examples.src: Many people suffered during the war.
examples.dst: 战争期间许多人受尽苦难。

examples.src: He suffered a great loss last year.
examples.dst: 他去年遭受了重大损失。

examples.src: The team suffered a defeat in the final.
examples.dst: 这支队伍在决赛中失利了。

confuse.diff: suffer 指遭受；suffix 指后缀。

examples.src: My grandfather suffers from a heart disease.
examples.dst: 我爷爷患有心脏病。

examples.src: The area is suffering from a lack of water.
examples.dst: 这个地区正受缺水之苦。

examples.src: She often suffers from headaches.
examples.dst: 她经常头痛。

confuse.diff: suffer from 指遭受病痛等；suffer for 指为某事付出代价。

examples.src: The old man felt deep loneliness after his wife died.
examples.dst: 妻子去世后，老人感到深深的孤独。

examples.src: Many students feel loneliness when they first leave home.
examples.dst: 许多学生第一次离开家时会感到孤独。

examples.src: Music helped her get over her loneliness.
examples.dst: 音乐帮她摆脱了孤独。

confuse.diff: loneliness 是名词；lonely 是形容词，孤独的。

examples.src: We drove along the highway for three hours.
examples.dst: 我们沿着公路开了三个小时。

examples.src: A new highway links the two cities.
examples.dst: 一条新的公路连接着这两座城市。

examples.src: There was a traffic jam on the highway.
examples.dst: 公路上发生了交通堵塞。

confuse.diff: highway 指公路；railway 指铁路。

examples.src: He is slowly recovering from his illness.
examples.dst: 他正在慢慢地从病中康复。

examples.src: The police recovered the stolen car.
examples.dst: 警方找回了被盗的汽车。

examples.src: It took the economy years to recover.
examples.dst: 经济花了好几年才恢复。

confuse.diff: recover 指恢复、找回；discover 指发现。

examples.src: I got tired of eating the same food every day.
examples.dst: 我吃腻了每天都一样的饭菜。

examples.src: She will never get tired of this song.
examples.dst: 她永远不会听腻这首歌。

examples.src: Don't get tired of learning English.
examples.dst: 不要对学英语感到厌倦。

confuse.diff: get tired of 指厌倦；get tired from 指因某事而疲劳。

examples.src: I am tired of waiting for the bus.
examples.dst: 我已经厌倦了等公共汽车。

examples.src: He is tired of his noisy neighbors.
examples.dst: 他对吵闹的邻居感到厌烦。

examples.src: Are you tired of this game?
examples.dst: 你玩腻了这个游戏吗？

confuse.diff: be tired of 指厌烦；be tired from 指因某事而累。

examples.src: I need to pack my bag for the trip.
examples.dst: 我得为旅行收拾包了。

examples.src: She bought a pack of gum.
examples.dst: 她买了一包口香糖。

examples.src: The bus was packed with students.
examples.dst: 公共汽车上挤满了学生。

confuse.diff: pack 指打包；park 指停车或公园。

means: 把(东西)收拾好；打点行装

examples.src: It's late, so let's pack up and go home.
examples.dst: 天晚了，我们收拾东西回家吧。

examples.src: She packed her books up quickly.
examples.dst: 她很快把书收拾好了。

examples.src: The workers packed up their tools at five.
examples.dst: 工人们五点钟收拾好了工具。

confuse.diff: pack up 指收拾打包；pick up 指拾起、接人。

examples.src: He carried a heavy suitcase up the stairs.
examples.dst: 他提着一个沉重的行李箱上楼。

examples.src: My suitcase is full of clothes.
examples.dst: 我的行李箱里装满了衣服。

examples.src: Please open your suitcase for inspection.
examples.dst: 请打开你的行李箱接受检查。

confuse.diff: suitcase 是旅行用的行李箱；briefcase 是办公用的公文包。

examples.src: He put on his overcoat and went out.
examples.dst: 他穿上大衣出去了。

examples.src: It is cold, so take your overcoat.
examples.dst: 天冷，带上你的大衣。

examples.src: She hung her overcoat on the hook.
examples.dst: 她把大衣挂在了挂钩上。

confuse.diff: overcoat 指大衣；overcome 指克服。

examples.src: Most teenagers like listening to music.
examples.dst: 大多数青少年喜欢听音乐。

examples.src: The book is written for teenagers.
examples.dst: 这本书是为青少年写的。

examples.src: She became a teenager last month.
examples.dst: 她上个月进入了十几岁的年纪。

confuse.diff: teenager 指青少年；teacher 指教师。

examples.src: She gets along well with her classmates.
examples.dst: 她和同学们相处得很好。

examples.src: How are you getting along with your new job?
examples.dst: 你的新工作进展如何？

examples.src: It is hard to get along with a rude person.
examples.dst: 和粗鲁的人很难相处。

confuse.diff: get along with 指相处；go along with 指同意、赞同。

examples.src: I don't like to listen to gossip.
examples.dst: 我不喜欢听闲话。

examples.src: They gossiped about their neighbors for an hour.
examples.dst: 他们聊了一个小时邻居的八卦。

examples.src: There is a lot of gossip about the movie star.
examples.dst: 关于那位电影明星有很多流言。

confuse.diff: gossip 指闲话；gospel 指福音。

examples.src: They fell in love at first sight.
examples.dst: 他们一见钟情。

examples.src: She fell in love with the small town.
examples.dst: 她爱上了那个小镇。

examples.src: Many tourists fall in love with this city.
examples.dst: 许多游客爱上了这座城市。

confuse.diff: fall in love 指开始爱上；be in love 指处于恋爱状态。

examples.dst: 他到底对你说了什么？

examples.src: It is exactly three o'clock.
examples.dst: 现在正好三点整。

examples.src: I think we should leave now. Exactly!
examples.dst: 我觉得我们现在该走了。完全正确！

confuse.diff: exactly 是副词；exact 是形容词，确切的。

examples.src: I disagree with your opinion.

examples.src: They often disagree about money.

examples.src: Some experts disagree on this question.
examples.dst: 一些专家在这个问题上意见不一。

confuse.diff: disagree 指不同意；disappear 指消失。

examples.src: I am grateful for your help.

examples.src: She was grateful to her teacher.
examples.dst: 她很感激她的老师。

examples.src: We are grateful that you came.
examples.dst: 你能来，我们很感激。

confuse.diff: grateful 指感激的；great 指伟大的、很好的。

examples.src: I dislike getting up early.
examples.dst: 我不喜欢早起。

examples.src: She has a strong dislike of noise.
examples.dst: 她非常讨厌噪音。

examples.src: He disliked the way she spoke.
examples.dst: 他不喜欢她说话的方式。

confuse.diff: dislike 指不喜欢；unlike 指不像、不同于。

examples.src: Come and join in the game.
examples.dst: 来参加这个游戏吧。

examples.src: Everyone joined in the singing.
examples.dst: 大家都加入了合唱。

examples.src: She was too shy to join in.
examples.dst: 她太害羞，不敢参与。

confuse.diff: join in 指参加正在进行的活动；join 指加入组织或团体。

examples.src: He left a tip for the waiter.
examples.dst: 他给服务员留了小费。

examples.src: Here are some tips for learning English.
examples.dst: 这里有一些学英语的小窍门。

examples.src: The tip of the pencil broke.
examples.dst: 铅笔尖断了。

confuse.diff: tip 指尖端、小费；top 指顶部。

examples.src: Firstly it is cheap, and secondly it is useful.

examples.dst: 这个倔强的孩子拒绝吃蔬菜。

examples.dst: 这块顽固的污渍很难去除。

examples.src: The students organized a charity sale.
examples.dst: 学生们组织了一次义卖活动。

examples.dst: 她按科目整理了笔记。

examples.dst: 你关心环境问题吗？

confuse.diff: care about 指关心、在乎；care for 指照顾或喜欢。

examples.dst: 坐火车是一段很长的旅程。

confuse.diff: journey 指旅程；journal 指日记、期刊。

examples.src: It was an event that no one forgot.
examples.dst: 那是一件谁也忘不了的事。

examples.src: She won first prize in the 100-meter event.
examples.dst: 她获得了100米项目的第一名。

confuse.diff: event 指事件；invent 指发明。

examples.src: He talked as if he knew everything about the case.
examples.dst: 他说话的样子好像对这个案子无所不知。

examples.src: It looks as if it is going to snow tonight.
examples.dst: 看起来今晚要下雪了。

examples.src: She treated me as if I were her own son.
examples.dst: 她待我就像对待亲生儿子一样。

confuse.diff: as if 表示好像；even if 表示即使。

examples.src: The long war was finally at an end.
examples.dst: 漫长的战争终于结束了。

examples.src: Our summer holiday is almost at an end.
examples.dst: 我们的暑假快结束了。

examples.src: His patience was at an end after hours of waiting.
examples.dst: 等了几个小时后，他的耐心已经耗尽。

confuse.diff: at an end 表示已经结束；in the end 表示最后、最终。

examples.src: China is a nation with a long history.
examples.dst: 中国是一个历史悠久的国家。

examples.src: The whole nation celebrated the victory.
examples.dst: 全国人民都庆祝这次胜利。

examples.src: The United Nations was set up to keep world peace.
examples.dst: 联合国成立的目的是维护世界和平。

confuse.diff: nation 指国家；notion 指概念、想法。

examples.src: The Grand Canal in China is over a thousand years old.
examples.dst: 中国的京杭大运河已有一千多年的历史。

examples.src: The Panama Canal links the Atlantic and the Pacific.
examples.dst: 巴拿马运河连接大西洋和太平洋。

examples.src: Farmers dug a canal to bring water to their fields.
examples.dst: 农民们挖了一条水渠把水引到田里。

confuse.diff: canal 指人工开凿的运河；channel 指海峡、航道或频道。

examples.src: Steam rose from the hot cup of tea.
examples.dst: 热茶杯上冒着热气。

examples.src: The invention of the steam engine changed industry.
examples.dst: 蒸汽机的发明改变了工业。

examples.src: My mother steamed fish for dinner.
examples.dst: 妈妈晚饭蒸了鱼。

confuse.diff: steam 指蒸汽；stream 指小河、水流。

examples.src: His shoes were covered in dirt after the hike.
examples.dst: 远足之后，他的鞋上沾满了泥土。

examples.src: Wash the dirt off your hands before dinner.
examples.dst: 吃饭前把手上的脏东西洗掉。

examples.src: They walked along a dirt road to the village.
examples.dst: 他们沿着一条土路走到村子。

confuse.diff: dirt 是名词，指污垢；dirty 是形容词，指肮脏的。

examples.src: The heavy rain ruined our picnic.
examples.dst: 大雨毁了我们的野餐。

examples.src: Tourists visit the ruins of the ancient city.
examples.dst: 游客们参观这座古城的遗址。

examples.src: One bad decision led to the ruin of his company.
examples.dst: 一次错误的决定导致他的公司破产。

confuse.diff: ruin 指毁坏；rule 指规则或统治。

examples.src: After the earthquake, the whole town was in ruins.
examples.dst: 地震之后，整座小镇成了一片废墟。

examples.src: The castle has been in ruins for centuries.
examples.dst: 这座城堡成为废墟已有几个世纪了。

examples.src: His dream of becoming a pilot lay in ruins.
examples.dst: 他当飞行员的梦想破灭了。

confuse.diff: in ruins 指成为废墟；in ruin 多指衰败、毁灭的状态。

examples.src: The war brought great suffering to ordinary people.
examples.dst: 战争给普通百姓带来了巨大的苦难。

examples.src: Doctors work hard to relieve the patients' suffering.
examples.dst: 医生们努力减轻病人的痛苦。

examples.src: The film tells a story of human suffering and hope.
examples.dst: 这部电影讲述了人类的苦难与希望的故事。

confuse.diff: suffering 是名词，指苦难；suffer 是动词，指遭受。

examples.src: Polar bears live in places of extreme cold.
examples.dst: 北极熊生活在极度寒冷的地方。

examples.src: He went to extremes to win the competition.
examples.dst: 他为了赢得比赛不惜采取极端手段。

examples.src: Extreme sports require careful training and safety checks.
examples.dst: 极限运动需要严格的训练和安全检查。

confuse.diff: extreme 是形容词，指极端的；extremely 是副词，指极其。

examples.src: He injured his leg while playing football.
examples.dst: 他踢足球时伤了腿。

examples.src: Several passengers were injured in the accident.
examples.dst: 几名乘客在事故中受伤。

examples.src: Such rumours may injure her reputation.
examples.dst: 这类谣言可能会损害她的名誉。

confuse.diff: injure 指使受伤；insure 指为……投保。

examples.src: There were only two survivors of the plane crash.
examples.dst: 这次空难只有两人幸存。

examples.src: The survivors were taken to a nearby hospital.
examples.dst: 幸存者被送往附近的医院。

examples.src: She is a cancer survivor who now helps other patients.
examples.dst: 她是一名癌症康复者，现在帮助其他病人。

confuse.diff: survivor 指幸存的人；survival 指生存、幸存这一状态。

examples.src: The fire destroyed the whole forest.
examples.dst: 这场大火烧毁了整片森林。

examples.src: Pollution is destroying the environment we live in.
examples.dst: 污染正在破坏我们赖以生存的环境。

examples.src: The earthquake destroyed thousands of homes.
examples.dst: 地震摧毁了数千座房屋。

confuse.diff: destroy 是动词，指毁坏；destruction 是名词，指毁灭。

examples.src: The old house was built of red bricks.
examples.dst: 这座老房子是用红砖建成的。

examples.src: Workers carried bricks to the building site.
examples.dst: 工人们把砖块搬到工地。

examples.src: A brick wall surrounds the garden.
examples.dst: 一堵砖墙围着花园。

confuse.diff: brick 指砖；break 指打破、休息。

examples.src: The Three Gorges Dam is one of the largest in the world.
examples.dst: 三峡大坝是世界上最大的水坝之一。

examples.src: The dam holds back water for the farmland downstream.
examples.dst: 这座水坝拦蓄河水，供下游农田使用。

examples.src: They dammed the river to produce electricity.
examples.dst: 他们在河上筑坝来发电。

confuse.diff: dam 指水坝；damp 指潮湿的。

examples.src: We followed the animal tracks through the snow.
examples.dst: 我们沿着雪地里的动物足迹前进。

examples.src: The train left the track because of the landslide.
examples.dst: 由于山体滑坡，火车脱轨了。

examples.src: Police tracked the thief to a small town.
examples.dst: 警方一路追踪小偷到了一个小镇。

confuse.diff: track 指轨道、足迹；truck 指卡车。

examples.src: Without electricity, my laptop is useless.
examples.dst: 没有电，我的笔记本电脑就没用了。

examples.src: It is useless to argue with him.
examples.dst: 和他争论是没有用的。

examples.src: The old map turned out to be useless.
examples.dst: 那张旧地图结果毫无用处。

confuse.diff: useless 表示无用的；useful 表示有用的。

examples.src: The sad news came as a great shock to all of us.
examples.dst: 这个悲伤的消息对我们所有人都是巨大的打击。

examples.src: She was shocked by the sudden noise.
examples.dst: 突如其来的响声把她吓了一跳。

examples.src: The patient was in a state of shock after the accident.
examples.dst: 事故发生后病人处于休克状态。

confuse.diff: shock 指震惊；shook 是 shake 的过去式。

examples.src: Firefighters rescued the children from the burning building.
examples.dst: 消防员从着火的大楼里救出了孩子们。

examples.src: The rescue team arrived within an hour.
examples.dst: 救援队在一小时内赶到了。

examples.src: He came to my rescue when I was in trouble.
examples.dst: 我遇到困难时，他前来救我。

confuse.diff: rescue 指营救；rest 指休息、剩余部分。

examples.src: The hunter set a trap for the wolf.
examples.dst: 猎人为狼设下了陷阱。

examples.src: Several miners were trapped underground after the collapse.
examples.dst: 坍塌之后，几名矿工被困在地下。

examples.src: Don't fall into the trap of comparing yourself with others.
examples.dst: 不要陷入与别人攀比的陷阱。

confuse.diff: trap 指陷阱；tap 指水龙头或轻敲。

examples.src: The storm cut off the electricity in the whole area.
examples.dst: 暴风雨使整个地区停电了。

examples.src: Solar panels turn sunlight into electricity.
examples.dst: 太阳能电池板把阳光转化为电能。

examples.src: We should save electricity in our daily life.
examples.dst: 我们在日常生活中应该节约用电。

confuse.diff: electricity 是名词，指电；electric 是形容词，指电的。

examples.src: The flood was the worst natural disaster in the area.
examples.dst: 这场洪水是该地区最严重的自然灾害。

examples.src: Volunteers rushed to the disaster area to help.
examples.dst: 志愿者们赶往灾区提供帮助。

examples.src: The school play turned out to be a complete disaster.
examples.dst: 学校的话剧演出最后彻底搞砸了。

confuse.diff: disaster 是名词，指灾难；disastrous 是形容词，指灾难性的。

examples.src: Rescuers dug out the survivors from the ruins.
examples.dst: 救援人员从废墟中挖出了幸存者。

examples.src: He dug out an old photo from the drawer.
examples.dst: 他从抽屉里翻出一张旧照片。

examples.src: We had to dig the car out of the snow.
examples.dst: 我们不得不把车从雪里挖出来。

confuse.diff: dig out 强调从被埋的地方挖出；dig up 强调把地下的东西翻挖出来。

examples.src: The dog buried a bone in the garden.
examples.dst: 狗把一根骨头埋在花园里。

examples.src: Many houses were buried by the landslide.
examples.dst: 许多房屋被山体滑坡掩埋了。

examples.src: He buried his face in his hands and cried.
examples.dst: 他双手捂脸哭了起来。

confuse.diff: bury 指埋葬；berry 指浆果。

examples.src: His grandfather worked in a coal mine for forty years.
examples.dst: 他的祖父在煤矿工作了四十年。

examples.src: The area was full of mines left over from the war.
examples.dst: 这一地区到处是战争遗留下来的地雷。

examples.src: They mine gold in the mountains of the north.
examples.dst: 他们在北方的山区开采黄金。

confuse.diff: mine 指矿或我的（东西）；mind 指头脑、介意。

examples.src: The miners were trapped underground for three days.
examples.dst: 矿工们被困在地下三天。

examples.src: Being a miner is a dangerous job.
examples.dst: 当矿工是一份危险的工作。

examples.src: The miners went on strike for better pay.
examples.dst: 矿工们为争取更高的工资而罢工。

confuse.diff: miner 指矿工；minor 指较小的、次要的。

examples.src: We took shelter from the rain under a big tree.
examples.dst: 我们躲在一棵大树下避雨。

examples.src: The homeless were given food and shelter.
examples.dst: 无家可归的人得到了食物和住所。

examples.src: The village built a shelter for the flood victims.
examples.dst: 村里为洪水灾民搭建了避难所。

confuse.diff: shelter 指庇护所；shelf 指架子。

examples.src: A great number of students joined the volunteer work.
examples.dst: 许多学生参加了志愿者工作。

examples.src: A number of problems have appeared in the project.
examples.dst: 这个项目出现了一些问题。

examples.src: A great number of trees were cut down in the past.
examples.dst: 过去有大量的树木被砍伐。

confuse.diff: a number of 表示许多，谓语用复数；the number of 表示……的数量，谓语用单数。

examples.src: What is the title of the book you are reading?
examples.dst: 你正在读的那本书叫什么名字？

examples.src: She won the world title at the age of twenty.
examples.dst: 她二十岁时就夺得了世界冠军。

examples.src: Doctor is a title given to people with a PhD.
examples.dst: 博士是授予拥有博士学位的人的头衔。

confuse.diff: title 指标题；tittle 指微小的一点，是很少用的词。

examples.src: The reporter asked the mayor several tough questions.
examples.dst: 记者向市长提了几个尖锐的问题。

examples.src: She dreams of becoming a war reporter.
examples.dst: 她梦想成为一名战地记者。

examples.src: Reporters gathered outside the court.
examples.dst: 记者们聚集在法院外面。

confuse.diff: reporter 指记者；report 指报告、报道。

examples.src: He bought a bar of chocolate at the shop.
examples.dst: 他在商店买了一块巧克力。

examples.src: The window was fitted with iron bars.
examples.dst: 窗户上装着铁栏杆。

examples.src: Poverty should not be a bar to education.
examples.dst: 贫穷不应成为接受教育的障碍。

confuse.diff: bar 指条、酒吧；bear 指熊或忍受。

examples.src: The storm caused serious damage to the crops.
examples.dst: 暴风雨使庄稼遭受严重损失。

examples.src: Smoking can damage your health.
examples.dst: 吸烟会损害你的健康。

examples.src: The flood did great damage to the town.
examples.dst: 洪水给小镇造成了巨大的破坏。

confuse.diff: damage 指损害；damp 指潮湿的。

examples.src: The loud thunder frightened the little girl.
examples.dst: 响亮的雷声把小女孩吓坏了。

examples.src: Don't frighten the birds away.
examples.dst: 别把鸟吓跑了。

examples.src: It frightens me to walk alone at night.
examples.dst: 夜里独自走路让我害怕。

confuse.diff: frighten 是动词，指使害怕；fright 是名词，指惊吓。

examples.src: The frightened child hid behind his mother.
examples.dst: 受惊的孩子躲到了妈妈身后。

examples.src: I was frightened when I heard footsteps behind me.
examples.dst: 听到身后有脚步声，我很害怕。

examples.src: She is frightened of speaking in public.
examples.dst: 她害怕当众讲话。

confuse.diff: frightened 形容人感到害怕；frightening 形容事物令人害怕。

examples.src: The horror film was too frightening for the young kids.
examples.dst: 这部恐怖片对小孩子来说太吓人了。

examples.src: It was a frightening experience to be lost in the forest.
examples.dst: 在森林里迷路是一次可怕的经历。

examples.src: The speed of the car was frightening.
examples.dst: 那辆车的速度令人害怕。

confuse.diff: frightening 形容事物令人害怕；frightened 形容人感到害怕。

examples.src: Congratulations on winning the first prize!
examples.dst: 祝贺你获得一等奖！

examples.src: He received many letters of congratulation after the match.
examples.dst: 比赛之后他收到了许多贺信。

examples.src: Please offer my congratulations to your parents.
examples.dst: 请向你的父母转达我的祝贺。

confuse.diff: congratulation 是名词，指祝贺；congratulate 是动词，指向……祝贺。

examples.src: You should not judge a person by his appearance.
examples.dst: 你不应该以貌取人。

examples.src: The judge sentenced him to two years in prison.
examples.dst: 法官判处他两年监禁。

examples.src: Three judges will choose the winner of the speech contest.
examples.dst: 三位评委将评选出演讲比赛的获胜者。

confuse.diff: judge 指判断、法官；jug 指水壶。

examples.src: I sincerely hope that you will recover soon.
examples.dst: 我真心希望你早日康复。

examples.src: She sincerely apologized for her mistake.
examples.dst: 她为自己的错误诚恳地道了歉。

examples.src: Yours sincerely, Li Hua.
examples.dst: 你诚挚的，李华。

confuse.diff: sincerely 是副词，指真诚地；sincere 是形容词，指真诚的。

examples.src: He found it hard to express his feelings in English.
examples.dst: 他觉得很难用英语表达自己的感受。

examples.src: She sent the package by express mail.
examples.dst: 她用快递寄出了这个包裹。

examples.src: I would like to express my thanks to all my teachers.
examples.dst: 我想向所有的老师表示感谢。

confuse.diff: express 是动词，指表达；expression 是名词，指表达、表情。

examples.src: We could see the outline of the mountains in the mist.
examples.dst: 我们能在薄雾中看到群山的轮廓。

examples.src: Make an outline before you write your essay.
examples.dst: 写作文之前先列一个提纲。

examples.src: The teacher outlined the plan for the new term.
examples.dst: 老师概述了新学期的计划。

confuse.diff: outline 指轮廓、概述；underline 指在下面划线。

examples.src: The news made headlines around the world.
examples.dst: 这条新闻成了全世界的头条。

examples.src: I only had time to read the headlines this morning.
examples.dst: 今天早上我只来得及看一下新闻标题。

examples.src: The headline of the article caught my attention.
examples.dst: 这篇文章的标题吸引了我的注意。

confuse.diff: headline 指新闻标题；headache 指头痛。

means: 骑自行车的人；自行车运动员

examples.src: The cyclist rode along the river every morning.
examples.dst: 那名骑车人每天早上沿着河边骑行。

examples.src: Cyclists should wear helmets for safety.
examples.dst: 骑车的人为了安全应该戴头盔。

examples.src: The young cyclist won the gold medal in the race.
examples.dst: 这位年轻的自行车运动员在比赛中夺得了金牌。

confuse.diff: cyclist 指骑车的人；cycle 指循环或骑自行车。

examples.src: The shop is famous for the high quality of its products.
examples.dst: 这家商店以产品质量高而闻名。

examples.src: Honesty is a quality that I admire in a friend.
examples.dst: 诚实是我在朋友身上欣赏的品质。

examples.src: Quality is more important than quantity.
examples.dst: 质量比数量更重要。

confuse.diff: quality 指质量；quantity 指数量。

examples.src: She is a warm-hearted woman who always helps the poor.
examples.dst: 她是个热心肠的女人，总是帮助穷人。

examples.src: The warm-hearted villagers took us in during the storm.
examples.dst: 风暴来临时，热情的村民们收留了我们。

examples.src: Our class teacher is warm-hearted and patient.
examples.dst: 我们的班主任热情又有耐心。

confuse.diff: warm-hearted 形容人热心；warm-blooded 指恒温的（动物）。

examples.src: What does this word mean?
examples.dst: 这个词是什么意思？

examples.src: I didn't mean to hurt your feelings.
examples.dst: 我不是有意伤害你的感情。

examples.src: It was mean of him to laugh at her mistake.
examples.dst: 他嘲笑她的错误，这很刻薄。

confuse.diff: mean 是动词原形；meant 是其过去式和过去分词。

examples.src: He is active in school activities and volunteer work.
examples.dst: 他积极参加学校活动和志愿者工作。

examples.src: Doing exercise keeps you active and healthy.
examples.dst: 锻炼能让你保持活力和健康。

examples.src: The volcano is still active.
examples.dst: 这座火山仍然活跃。

confuse.diff: active 是形容词，指积极的；actively 是副词，指积极地。

examples.src: The generous man gave a lot of money to the school.
examples.dst: 那位慷慨的男士给学校捐了很多钱。

examples.src: She is generous with her time and always helps others.
examples.dst: 她很愿意花时间，总是帮助别人。

examples.src: The restaurant serves generous portions.
examples.dst: 这家餐馆的分量很足。

confuse.diff: generous 指慷慨的；genuine 指真正的、真诚的。

examples.src: My father is an easy-going man who rarely gets angry.
examples.dst: 我父亲是个随和的人，很少发脾气。

examples.src: She has an easy-going attitude toward life.
examples.dst: 她对生活抱着随遇而安的态度。

examples.src: It is easy to get along with such easy-going people.
examples.dst: 和这样随和的人很容易相处。

examples.src: After a long holiday, she felt like her old self again.
examples.dst: 度过一个长假之后，她又觉得恢复了原来的自己。

examples.src: Knowing your true self is not easy.
examples.dst: 了解真实的自我并不容易。

examples.src: He showed his better self by helping the stranger.
examples.dst: 他通过帮助陌生人展现出了更好的一面。

confuse.diff: self 指自我；shelf 指架子。

examples.src: It was selfish of him to take all the food for himself.
examples.dst: 他把所有食物都占为己有，真是自私。

examples.src: Selfish people care only about their own interests.
examples.dst: 自私的人只关心自己的利益。

examples.src: Don't be so selfish; share the toys with your sister.
examples.dst: 别那么自私，把玩具和你妹妹分享吧。

confuse.diff: selfish 指自私的；selfless 指无私的。

examples.src: The nurse's selfless work saved many lives.
examples.dst: 那位护士无私的工作拯救了许多生命。

examples.src: Her selfless love for the children moved everyone.
examples.dst: 她对孩子们无私的爱感动了每一个人。

examples.src: Firefighters are known for their selfless spirit.
examples.dst: 消防员以其无私的精神而著称。

confuse.diff: selfless 指无私的；selfish 指自私的。

examples.src: The doctors worked selflessly during the epidemic.
examples.dst: 疫情期间，医生们无私地工作着。

examples.src: She selflessly gave up her seat to an old man.
examples.dst: 她无私地把座位让给了一位老人。

examples.src: He selflessly devoted his whole life to education.
examples.dst: 他无私地把一生奉献给了教育事业。

confuse.diff: selflessly 指无私地；selfishly 指自私地。

examples.src: She devoted her whole life to helping poor children.
examples.dst: 她毕生致力于帮助贫困儿童。

examples.src: He devotes two hours a day to practising the piano.
examples.dst: 他每天花两个小时练习钢琴。

examples.src: The scientist devoted himself to cancer research.
examples.dst: 这位科学家全身心投入癌症研究。

confuse.diff: devote 指奉献；devout 指虔诚的。

examples.src: He is a devoted father who spends every weekend with his kids.
examples.dst: 他是一位尽心尽责的父亲，每个周末都陪孩子们。

examples.src: She is devoted to her work as a teacher.
examples.dst: 她全身心投入教师的工作。

examples.src: The dog stayed with its devoted owner until the end.
examples.dst: 这条狗直到最后都陪伴着忠诚的主人。

confuse.diff: devoted 是形容词，指忠诚的；devote 是动词，指奉献。

examples.src: The Bible is the holy book of Christians.
examples.dst: 《圣经》是基督徒的圣书。

examples.src: Many English idioms come from the Bible.
examples.dst: 许多英语习语出自《圣经》。

examples.src: This dictionary is the Bible for English learners.
examples.dst: 这本词典是英语学习者的必备宝典。

confuse.diff: Bible 首字母大写指《圣经》；bible 小写指权威著作。

examples.src: The people fought bravely against the invaders.
examples.dst: 人们英勇地抵抗侵略者。

examples.src: The invaders burned the city to the ground.
examples.dst: 侵略者把这座城市烧成了平地。

examples.src: The Great Wall was built to keep out invaders.
examples.dst: 修建长城是为了抵御入侵者。

confuse.diff: invader 指入侵者；invasion 指入侵这一行为。

examples.src: The university was founded in 1898.
examples.dst: 这所大学创办于1898年。

examples.src: He founded a company that makes electric cars.
examples.dst: 他创办了一家生产电动汽车的公司。

examples.src: The People's Republic of China was founded in 1949.
examples.dst: 中华人民共和国成立于1949年。

confuse.diff: found 作“建立”时的过去式是 founded；found 同时是 find 的过去式，意为找到。

examples.src: France became a republic after the revolution.
examples.dst: 法国在大革命之后成为共和国。

examples.src: The country is a republic with an elected president.
examples.dst: 这个国家是一个拥有民选总统的共和国。

examples.src: The People's Republic of China was founded in 1949.
examples.dst: 中华人民共和国成立于1949年。

confuse.diff: republic 指共和国；republican 指共和主义者或共和制的。

examples.src: He is a man of principle and never tells lies.
examples.dst: 他是个有原则的人，从不说谎。

examples.src: The teacher explained the basic principles of physics.
examples.dst: 老师讲解了物理学的基本原理。

examples.src: In principle, I agree with your plan.
examples.dst: 原则上，我同意你的计划。

confuse.diff: principle 指原则；principal 指校长或主要的。

examples.src: Nationalism grew strong in Europe in the nineteenth century.
examples.dst: 十九世纪民族主义在欧洲日益强盛。

examples.src: Extreme nationalism can lead to conflict between countries.
examples.dst: 极端的民族主义可能导致国家之间的冲突。

examples.src: The essay discusses the rise of nationalism in Asia.
examples.dst: 这篇文章讨论了民族主义在亚洲的兴起。

confuse.diff: nationalism 指民族主义；nationality 指国籍。

examples.src: Fishing is the main livelihood of the villagers.
examples.dst: 捕鱼是村民们主要的生计。

examples.src: The drought destroyed the livelihood of many farmers.
examples.dst: 旱灾断了许多农民的生路。

examples.src: He earns his livelihood by driving a taxi.
examples.dst: 他靠开出租车谋生。

confuse.diff: livelihood 指生计；likelihood 指可能性。

examples.src: They hope to solve the problem in a peaceful way.
examples.dst: 他们希望用和平的方式解决这个问题。

examples.src: We enjoyed a peaceful weekend in the countryside.
examples.dst: 我们在乡下度过了一个宁静的周末。

examples.src: The sea was calm and peaceful at dawn.
examples.dst: 黎明时分，大海平静而安宁。

confuse.diff: peaceful 指平静的、和平的；peaceable 指爱好和平的、温和的。

examples.src: In the story, the giant lived in a castle in the clouds.
examples.dst: 故事里，巨人住在云端的城堡里。

examples.src: The company is a giant in the computer industry.
examples.dst: 这家公司是计算机行业的巨头。

examples.src: A giant wave hit the small boat.
examples.dst: 一个巨浪打向那条小船。

confuse.diff: giant 指巨人、巨大的；gain 指获得。

examples.src: The cat leaped onto the roof in one jump.
examples.dst: 猫一跃跳上了屋顶。

examples.src: The invention of the Internet was a great leap forward.
examples.dst: 互联网的发明是一次巨大的飞跃。

examples.src: Prices leapt by 10 percent last month.
examples.dst: 上个月物价猛涨了百分之十。

confuse.diff: leap 指跳跃；leak 指泄漏。

examples.src: The moon landing was a giant step for mankind.
examples.dst: 登月是人类迈出的一大步。

examples.src: Pollution is a serious threat to mankind.
examples.dst: 污染对人类是严重的威胁。

examples.src: The history of mankind is full of wars and hope.
examples.dst: 人类的历史充满了战争与希望。

confuse.diff: mankind 与 humankind 意思相同，humankind 更避免性别指向。

examples.src: She wants to be a lawyer and defend the poor.
examples.dst: 她想成为一名律师，为穷人辩护。

examples.src: You should talk to a lawyer before signing the contract.
examples.dst: 签合同之前你应该先咨询律师。

examples.src: The lawyer argued that his client was innocent.
examples.dst: 律师辩称他的当事人是无辜的。

confuse.diff: lawyer 指律师；liar 指说谎的人。

examples.src: Under the teacher's guidance, we finished the experiment.
examples.dst: 在老师的指导下，我们完成了实验。

examples.src: Students often need guidance in choosing a major.
examples.dst: 学生在选择专业时常常需要指导。

examples.src: She gave me useful guidance on how to write an essay.
examples.dst: 她就如何写作文给了我有益的指导。

confuse.diff: guidance 指指导；guidebook 指旅游指南书。

examples.src: It is not legal to drive without a licence.
examples.dst: 无证驾驶是不合法的。

examples.src: The company will take legal action against him.
examples.dst: 公司将对他采取法律行动。

examples.src: You can get free legal advice at this centre.
examples.dst: 你可以在这个中心获得免费的法律咨询。

confuse.diff: legal 指合法的；illegal 指非法的。

examples.src: The school fees go up every year.
examples.dst: 学费每年都在上涨。

examples.src: There is no entrance fee for children under six.
examples.dst: 六岁以下儿童免收门票。

examples.src: The lawyer charges a high fee for his service.
examples.dst: 这位律师的服务收费很高。

confuse.diff: fee 指服务费用；fare 指交通车费。

examples.src: My grandmother keeps her passbook in a safe place.
examples.dst: 我奶奶把存折放在安全的地方。

examples.src: He checked the balance in his passbook.
examples.dst: 他查看了存折上的余额。

examples.src: She lost her passbook and went to the bank to report it.
examples.dst: 她丢了存折，去银行挂失。

confuse.diff: passbook 指存折；passport 指护照。

examples.src: His father has been out of work for six months.
examples.dst: 他父亲已经失业六个月了。

examples.src: Many people were out of work during the economic crisis.
examples.dst: 经济危机期间，许多人失业了。

examples.src: She is out of work and looking for a new job.
examples.dst: 她失业了，正在找新工作。

confuse.diff: out of work 指失业；out of order 指（机器）出故障。

examples.src: We are hopeful that the weather will improve tomorrow.
examples.dst: 我们希望明天天气会好转。

examples.src: She gave him a hopeful smile.
examples.dst: 她给了他一个充满希望的微笑。

examples.src: The doctor said the situation was hopeful.
examples.dst: 医生说情况还是有希望的。

confuse.diff: hopeful 指充满希望的；hopeless 指绝望的。

means: 非洲人国民大会（简称非国大，南非政党）

examples.src: The ANC led the struggle against apartheid in South Africa.
examples.dst: 非国大领导了南非反对种族隔离的斗争。

examples.src: Nelson Mandela became the leader of the ANC.
examples.dst: 纳尔逊·曼德拉成为非国大的领袖。

examples.src: The ANC won the first free election in 1994.
examples.dst: 非国大在1994年首次自由选举中获胜。

examples.src: He spent his youth in a small village by the sea.
examples.dst: 他在海边的一个小村庄度过了青年时代。

examples.src: The youth of today face more pressure than before.
examples.dst: 当今的年轻人面临比以前更大的压力。

examples.src: Several youths were helping to clean the beach.
examples.dst: 几个年轻人正在帮忙清理海滩。

confuse.diff: youth 是名词，指青春、青年；young 是形容词，指年轻的。

examples.src: Our school team won the basketball league this year.
examples.dst: 今年我们学校的球队赢得了篮球联赛冠军。

examples.src: The League of Nations was set up after World War I.
examples.dst: 国际联盟是在第一次世界大战后成立的。

examples.src: The two countries formed a league to protect trade.
examples.dst: 两国结成联盟以保护贸易。

confuse.diff: league 指联盟、联赛；colleague 指同事。

examples.src: He joined the Youth League when he was fourteen.
examples.dst: 他十四岁时加入了共青团。

examples.src: The Youth League organized a tree-planting activity.
examples.dst: 共青团组织了一次植树活动。

examples.src: She serves as the secretary of the school Youth League.
examples.dst: 她担任学校共青团的书记。

examples.src: The singer walked onto the stage and everyone applauded.
examples.dst: 歌手走上舞台，大家都鼓起掌来。

examples.src: The project has reached an important stage.
examples.dst: 这个项目已进入重要阶段。

examples.src: Our class staged a play at the end of the term.
examples.dst: 期末时我们班上演了一出戏剧。

confuse.diff: stage 指舞台、阶段；state 指状态、国家、州。

examples.src: Citizens over eighteen have the right to vote.
examples.dst: 年满十八岁的公民有投票权。

examples.src: We voted for Li Ming as the class monitor.
examples.dst: 我们投票选李明当班长。

examples.src: The plan was passed by a vote of 30 to 10.
examples.dst: 该计划以30票对10票获得通过。

confuse.diff: vote 指投票；note 指笔记、注意。

examples.src: The enemy attacked the city at dawn.
examples.dst: 敌人在黎明时分袭击了这座城市。

examples.src: The newspaper attacked the government's new policy.
examples.dst: 报纸抨击了政府的新政策。

examples.src: He died of a heart attack at the age of sixty.
examples.dst: 他在六十岁时死于心脏病发作。

confuse.diff: attack 指攻击；attach 指附上、系上。

examples.src: Violence is never the right way to solve problems.
examples.dst: 暴力绝不是解决问题的正确方法。

examples.src: The film was criticized for showing too much violence.
examples.dst: 这部电影因暴力镜头过多而受到批评。

examples.src: Violence broke out between the two groups in the street.
examples.dst: 两伙人在街上发生了暴力冲突。

confuse.diff: violence 是名词，指暴力；violent 是形容词，指暴力的。

examples.src: As a matter of fact, I have never been abroad.
examples.dst: 事实上，我从来没有出过国。

examples.src: I thought it would be hard, but as a matter of fact it was easy.
examples.dst: 我以为会很难，其实很容易。

examples.src: As a matter of fact, he is not as shy as he looks.
examples.dst: 其实他并不像看起来那么害羞。

confuse.diff: as a matter of fact 表示事实上；no matter 表示无论。

examples.src: The old bridge was blown up during the war.
examples.dst: 那座旧桥在战争期间被炸毁了。

examples.src: The children helped to blow up the balloons for the party.
examples.dst: 孩子们帮忙为聚会给气球充气。

examples.src: He blew up at me when I was late again.
examples.dst: 我再次迟到时，他对我大发脾气。

confuse.diff: blow up 指爆炸、充气；blow out 指吹灭。

examples.src: All people are equal before the law.
examples.dst: 法律面前人人平等。

examples.src: Two plus three equals five.
examples.dst: 二加三等于五。

examples.src: Girls should have equal opportunities in education.
examples.dst: 女孩在教育方面应有平等的机会。

confuse.diff: equal 是形容词，指平等的；equally 是副词，指同等地。

examples.src: If you cheat in the exam, you will be in trouble.
examples.dst: 如果你考试作弊，就会有麻烦。

examples.src: The company has been in trouble since last year.
examples.dst: 这家公司从去年起就陷入了困境。

examples.src: Call me if you are ever in trouble.
examples.dst: 你要是遇到麻烦，就给我打电话。

confuse.diff: in trouble 指有麻烦、处境艰难；in danger 指处于危险中。

examples.src: Are you willing to help us clean the classroom?
examples.dst: 你愿意帮我们打扫教室吗？

examples.src: She is always willing to listen to others' opinions.
examples.dst: 她总是乐意倾听别人的意见。

examples.src: The villagers were willing workers on the new road.
examples.dst: 村民们自愿参加修建新路的劳动。

confuse.diff: willing 指愿意的；wilful 指任性的、故意的。

examples.src: It is unfair to punish the whole class for one student's mistake.
examples.dst: 因为一个学生的错误而惩罚全班是不公平的。

examples.src: Many people think the new rule is unfair to women.
examples.dst: 许多人认为这项新规定对女性不公平。

examples.src: He felt that he had been treated unfairly.
examples.dst: 他觉得自己受到了不公正的对待。

confuse.diff: unfair 指不公平的；unfit 指不适合的。

examples.src: When I was in trouble, I turned to my teacher for help.
examples.dst: 遇到困难时，我向老师求助。

examples.src: Please turn to page 25 in your textbook.
examples.dst: 请把课本翻到第25页。

examples.src: After the failure, he turned to writing.
examples.dst: 失败之后，他转而从事写作。

confuse.diff: turn to 指求助、转向；turn into 指变成。

examples.src: The writer quoted a famous poem in his speech.
examples.dst: 作家在演讲中引用了一首著名的诗。

examples.src: She quoted Confucius to support her opinion.
examples.dst: 她引用孔子的话来支持自己的观点。

examples.src: The builder gave us a quote for the repairs.
examples.dst: 建筑商给了我们一份维修报价。

confuse.diff: quote 指引用；quite 指相当、完全。

examples.src: The prisoner was released after twenty years.
examples.dst: 这名囚犯在二十年后被释放。

examples.src: The film will be released next month.
examples.dst: 这部电影将于下个月上映。

examples.src: Exercise helps to release stress.
examples.dst: 锻炼有助于缓解压力。

confuse.diff: release 指释放、发布；relief 指缓解、宽慰。

examples.src: Don't lose heart even if you fail the first time.
examples.dst: 即使第一次失败了也不要灰心。

examples.src: The team did not lose heart after the heavy defeat.
examples.dst: 球队在惨败之后并没有丧失信心。

examples.src: He never lost heart in the face of difficulties.
examples.dst: 面对困难，他从未灰心。

confuse.diff: lose heart 指灰心；lose one's heart to 指爱上某人。

means: 罗本岛（南非开普敦附近的岛屿，曾关押政治犯）

examples.src: Nelson Mandela was kept on Robben Island for eighteen years.
examples.dst: 纳尔逊·曼德拉在罗本岛被关押了十八年。

examples.src: Robben Island is now a museum and a World Heritage Site.
examples.dst: 罗本岛现在是一座博物馆和世界遗产地。

examples.src: Tourists take a boat from Cape Town to Robben Island.
examples.dst: 游客从开普敦乘船前往罗本岛。

examples.src: Two prisoners escaped from the jail last night.
examples.dst: 昨晚有两名囚犯从监狱逃跑了。

examples.src: He narrowly escaped death in the car accident.
examples.dst: 他在车祸中死里逃生。

examples.src: Reading is an escape from the pressure of daily life.
examples.dst: 阅读是对日常生活压力的一种逃避。

confuse.diff: escape 指逃脱；escalate 指逐步升级。

examples.src: She wrapped herself in a warm blanket on the sofa.
examples.dst: 她裹着暖和的毯子坐在沙发上。

examples.src: The volunteers handed out blankets to the flood victims.
examples.dst: 志愿者们给洪水灾民发放毯子。

examples.src: A blanket of snow covered the village.
examples.dst: 一层厚厚的白雪覆盖着村庄。

confuse.diff: blanket 指毯子；bracket 指括号或支架。

examples.src: Parents have a duty to educate their children.
examples.dst: 父母有责任教育自己的孩子。

examples.src: The government plans to educate people about healthy eating.
examples.dst: 政府计划向民众普及健康饮食知识。

examples.src: She was educated at a famous university in Beijing.
examples.dst: 她在北京一所著名的大学接受教育。

confuse.diff: educate 是动词，指教育；education 是名词，指教育事业。

examples.src: He is a well-educated man who speaks three languages.
examples.dst: 他是一位受过良好教育的人，会说三种语言。

examples.src: Educated people should set a good example for society.
examples.dst: 受过教育的人应当为社会树立榜样。

examples.src: The company wants to hire highly educated young people.
examples.dst: 这家公司想招聘受过高等教育的年轻人。

confuse.diff: educated 指受过教育的人；educational 指教育方面的、有教育意义的。

examples.src: The new government came to power after the election.
examples.dst: 新政府在选举之后上台执政。

examples.src: Hitler came to power in Germany in 1933.
examples.dst: 希特勒于1933年在德国掌权。

examples.src: Mandela came to power in 1994 as the first black president of South Africa.
examples.dst: 曼德拉于1994年出任南非首位黑人总统。

confuse.diff: come to power 强调上台的动作；in power 表示处于掌权状态。

examples.src: The old man sat by the road and begged for food.
examples.dst: 老人坐在路边乞讨食物。

examples.src: She begged her parents to let her go to the concert.
examples.dst: 她恳求父母让她去听音乐会。

examples.src: I beg your pardon, could you repeat that?
examples.dst: 对不起，您能再说一遍吗？

confuse.diff: beg 指乞求；bag 指袋子。

examples.src: We visit our relatives during the Spring Festival.
examples.dst: 春节期间我们走亲访友。

examples.src: Happiness is relative; it depends on how you see things.
examples.dst: 幸福是相对的，取决于你如何看待事物。

examples.src: The cost of living is high relative to our income.
examples.dst: 相对于我们的收入来说，生活成本很高。

confuse.diff: relative 指亲戚；relation 指关系。

examples.src: The children screamed in terror when the lights went out.
examples.dst: 灯一灭，孩子们吓得尖叫起来。

examples.src: The city lived in terror during the bombing.
examples.dst: 轰炸期间，这座城市笼罩在恐怖之中。

examples.src: The government promised to fight terror in all its forms.
examples.dst: 政府承诺打击一切形式的恐怖主义。

confuse.diff: terror 是名词，指恐怖；terrible 是形容词，指可怕的、糟糕的。

examples.src: Cruelty to animals is against the law in many countries.
examples.dst: 在许多国家，虐待动物是违法的。

examples.src: The prisoners suffered terrible cruelty in the camp.
examples.dst: 囚犯们在营地里遭受了可怕的虐待。

examples.src: She could not bear the cruelty of the war.
examples.dst: 她无法忍受战争的残酷。

confuse.diff: cruelty 是名词，指残忍；cruel 是形容词，指残忍的。

examples.src: The police offered a reward for finding the missing child.
examples.dst: 警方悬赏寻找失踪的孩子。

examples.src: Hard work will bring you a good reward in the end.
examples.dst: 努力终将给你带来好的回报。

examples.src: The teacher rewarded him with a book for his progress.
examples.dst: 老师奖给他一本书，以表彰他的进步。

confuse.diff: reward 指对行为的奖赏、报酬；award 指正式授予的奖项。

examples.src: They set up a company to sell organic food.
examples.dst: 他们成立了一家销售有机食品的公司。

examples.src: The students set up a tent beside the lake.
examples.dst: 学生们在湖边搭起了帐篷。

examples.src: The school set up a fund to help poor students.
examples.dst: 学校设立了一项基金来帮助贫困学生。

confuse.diff: set up 指建立；set off 指出发、引发。

examples.src: Please translate this sentence into English.
examples.dst: 请把这个句子翻译成英语。

examples.src: The judge gave him a sentence of five years in prison.
examples.dst: 法官判处他五年徒刑。

examples.src: The court sentenced the thief to six months in jail.
examples.dst: 法院判处这名小偷六个月监禁。

confuse.diff: sentence 指句子、判决；sentiment 指情感、感想。

examples.src: He was sentenced to life in prison for the crime.
examples.dst: 他因这起罪行被判处终身监禁。

examples.src: Mandela was sentenced to life imprisonment in 1964.
examples.dst: 曼德拉于1964年被判处终身监禁。

examples.src: The driver was sentenced to two years for causing the accident.
examples.dst: 这名司机因造成事故被判处两年徒刑。

confuse.diff: be sentenced to 后接刑罚；be sentenced for 后接罪名。

examples.src: Many people joined the anti-war march.
examples.dst: 许多人参加了反战游行。

examples.src: The anti-virus software protects my computer.
examples.dst: 杀毒软件保护着我的电脑。

examples.src: The new law is part of the anti-smoking campaign.
examples.dst: 这项新法律是禁烟运动的一部分。

confuse.diff: anti- 表示反对；ante- 表示在……之前。

means: 反对黑人的；歧视黑人的

examples.src: The government passed anti-black laws during the apartheid era.
examples.dst: 种族隔离时期，政府通过了歧视黑人的法律。

examples.src: Anti-black behaviour should never be accepted in society.
examples.dst: 社会决不应容忍歧视黑人的行为。

examples.src: The movement fought against anti-black discrimination.
examples.dst: 这场运动反对对黑人的歧视。

examples.src: The president will make a speech on television tonight.
examples.dst: 总统今晚将在电视上发表讲话。

examples.src: Mandela became the first black president of South Africa.
examples.dst: 曼德拉成为南非首位黑人总统。

examples.src: She was elected president of the student union.
examples.dst: 她当选为学生会主席。

confuse.diff: president 指总统、会长；resident 指居民。

examples.src: Mandela won the Nobel Peace Prize in 1993.
examples.dst: 曼德拉于1993年获得诺贝尔和平奖。

examples.src: The Nobel Peace Prize is awarded to those who work for world peace.
examples.dst: 诺贝尔和平奖授予为世界和平而努力的人。

examples.src: She dreams of winning the Nobel Peace Prize one day.
examples.dst: 她梦想有一天能获得诺贝尔和平奖。

confuse.diff: Nobel Peace Prize 是诺贝尔和平奖；Nobel Prize 泛指诺贝尔奖的各个奖项。

examples.src: In my opinion, the plan is too risky.
examples.dst: 依我看，这个计划风险太大。

examples.src: Everyone has the right to express his own opinion.
examples.dst: 每个人都有权表达自己的观点。

examples.src: She has a high opinion of her new teacher.
examples.dst: 她对新老师评价很高。

confuse.diff: opinion 指意见；opening 指开口、开幕。
